Methodological Governance

Mathematical Formulation & Algorithmic Architecture

The continuous Pressure Index (PI) maps delivery-level leverage to [0, 1] across 199,208 deliveries. It replaces crude match-level filters with instantaneous, context-aware physics.

1. Pressure Batter Score (PBS)
PBS = [0.45·(SR_hp / 140) + 0.35·(Avg_hp / 30) + 0.20·(Bdry%_hp / 0.18)] × Shrinkage_bat × Consistency_match
  • • 0.45 SR Weight: Prioritizes rapid boundary clearing under scoreboard squeeze.
  • • 0.35 Avg Weight: Rewards wicket preservation during tight chases.
  • • 0.20 Boundary Weight: Specifically penalizes dot balls in death overs.
2. Pressure Bowler Score (PBoS)
PBoS = [0.45·(8.5 / Econ_hp) + 0.35·(18 / SR_hp) + 0.20·(Dot%_hp / 0.35)] × Shrinkage_bowl × Consistency_match
  • • 0.45 Econ Inversion: Directly rewards sub-8.5 economy rates under extreme squeeze.
  • • 0.35 Strike Rate Weight: Rewards crucial breakthrough wicket-taking in death overs.
  • • 0.20 Dot Ball Weight: Captures pressure-building maiden/choke capabilities.

Statistical Rigor & Auction Constraint Audits

1. Overseas Age Filter

Strict exclusion of uncapped overseas players aged ≥22. Only elite prodigies (Wellalage, 21) admitted.

Purged: Yasir Ali, Balbirnie, Rasooli, Humphreys.

2. Proven IPL Caps

All veteran overseas targets possess verified IPL caps (Hope, Roy, Williamson, Wade, Abbott, Joseph).

Guarantees immediate auction readiness.

3. Empirical Bayesian Shrinkage

Multiplier = N_hp / (N_hp + K), with K_bat=40, K_bowl=50

Prevents small sample size anomalies from distorting player rankings.

4. Match Consistency Factor

Multiplier = 0.75 + 0.25 / (1 + CV_match)

Penalizes volatile boom-or-bust performers; rewards ice-cool repeatability across matches.
